parsed.g: Identify which customer has completed the most number of orders in the entire history of the Magento store.
R_t: Successfully log in to the Magento Admin panel
Navigate to the Orders section or Customer section
Identify the customer with the most completed orders in the entire history
parsed.e_t: The page is the Magento Admin login page. An error message is displayed: 'The account sign-in was incorrect or your account is disabled temporarily. Please wait and try again later.' The username field (id 60) contains 'admin'. The password field (id 87) is empty. The Sign in button (id 88) is present. The agent has not yet successfully logged in.
C: The admin account may be temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts; the agent must wait before retrying or use correct credentials
The password field must be filled before clicking Sign in

F_t.action: type [31] [admin] [0] followed by click [32] (Sign in) at step 3
F_t.cause: Login failed with error 'The account sign-in was incorrect or your account is disabled temporarily.' The password 'admin' was entered but the credentials were rejected by the server, as evidenced by the error message in the DOM at step 4.

Agent typed username into field id 60 but did not yet submit; this alone does not constitute a failed login attempt, but the prior failed login left the account in a locked/error state per DOM error message.

Agent typed password into field id 87 but the password field still appears empty in the ground-truth DOM (no text shown inside id 87), and the error message from the previous failed attempt remains visible. The login has not been submitted yet at this step.

K_t: The Magento Admin login URL is being used; credentials 'admin'/'admin' have failed at least once, triggering a temporary lockout warning.
The error message states: 'The account sign-in was incorrect or your account is disabled temporarily. Please wait and try again later.'
The correct password for the admin account may not be 'admin'; alternative credentials may be needed.
To find the customer with the most completed orders, the agent will need to access Sales > Orders or Customers section in the Magento Admin panel after successful login.
